Authentic Bengali Biyer Biodata Format (বাংলা বিয়ের বায়োডাটা गाइड)

A classic Bengali matrimonial profile (Biyer Biodata) blends cultural refinement—opening with Shree Shree Prajapataye Namah—with essential astrological attributes (Rashi, Gana, Gotra, Mangalik), academic/cultural pursuits, and ancestral background (Ghoti / Bangal heritage).

Biodata SectionEssential Fields & Cultural AttributesWhy Families Expect It
1. Auspicious Prajapati Invocation|| শ্রীশ্রী প্রজাপতয়ে নমঃ || (Shree Shree Prajapataye Namah) header & sacred motifClassic auspicious opening invoking Lord Brahma/Prajapati in Bengali weddings
2. Personal & Astrological (ঠিকুজি-কোষ্ঠী)Date, Time & Place of Birth, Rashi (রাশি), Nakshatra (নক্ষত্র), Gana (গণ — দেব/মনুষ্য/রাক্ষস), Gotra (গোত্র), and Mangalik statusKey parameters for Bengali Kushthi / Patrika matching
3. Academic, Professional & Cultural InterestsQualifications, University, Designation, Organization, plus Hobbies (Rabindra Sangeet, Classical Music, Literature, Fine Arts)Bengali matrimonial profiles place strong emphasis on education and cultural pursuits
4. Family Background (পারিবারিক পরিচয়)Parents & Siblings Details, Ancestral Roots, Current Residence (Kolkata, Salt Lake, Siliguri, or Abroad), and Contact InfoProvides complete family context for alliance conversations

Does this studio include the East Indian / Bengali Sunburst Kundali chart?

Yes! In Tab 4 (Studio & Kundali), choose "East Indian / Bengali Sunburst Chart" from the Kundali Chart Tradition dropdown to add an authentic Bengali Kushthi diagram.

Can I use "Shree Shree Prajapataye Namah" as the top heading?

Yes. In Tab 2 (Header & Photo), type or select "|| Shree Shree Prajapataye Namah ||" or "|| শ্রীশ্রী প্রজাপতয়ে নমঃ ||" in the Auspicious Invocation field.

Can I generate the biodata in Bengali script (বাংলা) or English?

Both! Switch between Bengali (বাংলা) and English labels at any time with zero data loss.

Are all Bengali marriage biodata templates free to download?

Yes, all 242 templates and PDF, Editable Word (.docx), and HD PNG exports are 100% free with no watermark.
